panel.alt: The agreed survey carrying fee has been paid against the completed order. Its earned coins lie in a stable small pile beside Aren’s retained morning savings packet. With his gloves already removed on the table and the harness and empty gray bag unbuckled on his chair, Aren sits with bare hands at rest as Ossa places a simple late meal before him. Sera closes the completed order beside them.

copy.speaker: Aren
copy.text: Then I can sit for this one.
